subject: nextjs
summary: Explains the differences between Server Components and Client Components in Next.js App Router, the role of 'use client' directive, available APIs for each type, and composition patterns.
key_points: All components in App Router are Server Components by default — 'use client' opts into client rendering.
'use client' creates a boundary: all children imported by the file become client components.
Server Components can access databases and server-only APIs; Client Components can use hooks and browser APIs.
misconceptions: Every component needs 'use client' to work in the browser.
Client Components can import and use server-only modules like database clients.
Functions can be passed as props from Server Components to Client Components.
check_questions: What is the default component type in App Router?
What happens if you import a server-only module in a 'use client' file?
How do you pass server data to a client component?
